sections.title: Agreement Overview
sections.content:
VOLUNTEER SIGN-OFF AGREEMENT

Version 1.0
Author: @sunnybasin
Effective Date: November 15, 2026
Last Revised: November 16, 2026
 Agreement Last Revised: November 17, 2026

This Sign-Off Agreement constitutes a formal acknowledgment of the policies, procedures, obligations, and expectations associated with participation as a volunteer member of the team. By reviewing and signing this document, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to comply with all applicable team policies, agreements, and confidentiality requirements contained herein.

This process has been implemented to ensure continued engagement, accountability, and commitment among all volunteers. Your signature serves as confirmation of your intent to remain an active participant within the specific team and your willingness to fulfill the responsibilities outlined in this document.

If you do not understand any provision of this agreement, disagree with any requirement, or require clarification regarding your rights or obligations, you should seek clarification before signing. Questions, concerns, or objections may be directed to @sunnybasin on Discord, through https://sunnybasin.pp.ua/contact, or to @ragdulls on Discord.

DOCUMENT CONTENTS

Section A: Overview
Provides a summary of the agreements, policies, and obligations contained within this document and serves as an introduction to the provisions that follow.

Section B: Volunteer and Contribution Agreements
Sets forth the terms governing volunteer participation, intellectual property contributions, assignment of rights, and other obligations between volunteers and the team. This section also outlines potential disciplinary measures that may result from violations of these agreements.

Section C: Team Policies and Standards
Establishes the rules, procedures, standards of conduct, and operational requirements applicable to all volunteers. Compliance with this section is a condition of continued participation on the team.

Section D: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
Defines the confidentiality obligations applicable to all volunteers and explains the restrictions governing the disclosure, distribution, or use of confidential project information, internal discussions, and other protected materials.

Failure to comply with the provisions contained in this document may result in disciplinary action, suspension, or removal from the team at the discretion of team leadership.

Please do not provide any personal information while completing this sign-off process.

Upon completion of all required sections and execution of the agreement, please notify either @sunnybasin or @ragdulls on Discord.

END OF SECTION A: AGREEMENT OVERVIEW

sections.title: Volunteer and Contribution Agreements
sections.content:
VOLUNTEER PARTICIPATION AND CONTRIBUTION POLICIES

Version 1.0
Author: @sunnybasin
Last Revised: November 16, 2026

This section establishes the expectations and procedures applicable to volunteers participating in team projects. It also describes how the team may use project contributions, how volunteers may raise workload or contribution concerns, and what actions team leadership may take in response to policy violations.

By signing the team’s sign-off document, volunteers acknowledge that they have reviewed these policies and agree to follow them while participating in team projects. Questions or concerns may be directed to @sunnybasin or @ragdulls.

B.1 · Volunteer Status and Compensation

All team members participate on a volunteer basis. Unless @ragdulls or @sunnybasin has expressly announced otherwise, volunteers should not expect payment for work, assets, ideas, or other contributions provided to a team project.

B.2 · Participation and Project Commitments

Volunteers are expected to make a reasonable contribution to each project they join. Workload and schedules may vary based on the project’s scope, timeline, and the volunteer’s stated availability.

Volunteers should complete agreed-upon tasks and provide timely, truthful updates about their progress. If a volunteer cannot complete a task or expects a delay, they should notify team leadership as soon as reasonably possible.

After joining a project, volunteers are expected to give it appropriate priority and avoid accepting another major team project if doing so would prevent them from meeting existing commitments. Volunteers may take on small projects while participating in a larger project, provided they can continue to meet their existing commitments. Major additional projects should be discussed with team leadership in advance.

A volunteer who needs to reduce their workload or leave a project should notify team leadership as soon as reasonably possible and provide a status update on any work in progress.

B.3 · Project Contributions and Use

Before contributing work to a project, volunteers should identify any pre-existing material they want to keep separate from the project and discuss its use with team leadership.

By contributing work to a team project, a volunteer gives the team permission to use, reproduce, modify, and include that contribution in the project and its related materials. This permission continues if the volunteer later leaves the team.

A contribution should be used for the project for which it was provided. Use in another project requires the contributor’s agreement or approval from @sunnybasin or @ragdulls.

Volunteers must not contribute material they do not have permission to use. This includes material belonging to another person or project, or material subject to terms that conflict with the intended project use.

The team will make reasonable efforts to credit contributors in a manner appropriate to the project. Volunteers who want specific material excluded from team use must identify it before contributing it and obtain agreement from team leadership about how it may be used.

Contribution License Terms

For contributions covered by these terms:

- All assets contributed are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International license (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and are owned by the development team.
- All contributed assets remain under the ownership of the development team regardless of a contributor’s resignation or suspension.
- Contributors agree not to bring a copyright or DMCA claim against anyone using an asset contributed to the team, provided that the use has been authorized.
- Contributors agree to all applicable terms of the team’s Individual Contributor License Agreement (ICLA).

B.4 · Exceptions and Workload Adjustments

Team leadership may adjust a volunteer’s workload or project commitments to account for overlapping work, availability, project schedules, or other relevant circumstances.

Volunteers may request an adjustment when existing work conflicts with a new project. If a project is in its early stages and remains on schedule, team leadership may excuse a volunteer from that project or reduce their assigned tasks so they can focus on other work.

Volunteers should notify team leadership before taking on a major additional project. Small projects are permitted when they do not prevent the volunteer from meeting existing commitments.

B.5 · Policy Violations and Consequences

Team leadership may review reported violations of these policies and consider the circumstances, the impact on the project, and any relevant communication before deciding what action to take.

Depending on the nature and seriousness of the violation, consequences may include:

- Temporary suspension from a team;
- Permanent suspension or expulsion from a team;
- Temporary suspension from participating in any team associated with @sunnybasin or @ragdulls; or
- Permanent suspension or blacklisting from participating in any team associated with @sunnybasin or @ragdulls.

Team leadership should communicate its decision to the volunteer and, where applicable, explain any steps for returning to the project or team.

END OF SECTION B: VOLUNTEER PARTICIPATION AND CONTRIBUTION POLICIES

sections.title: Team Policies
sections.content:
TEAM POLICIES

Version 1.0
Author: @sunnybasin
Last Revised: November 17, 2026

This section establishes the policies and operational requirements applicable to all volunteers affiliated with a specific team operated by @sunnybasin or @ragdulls.

C.1 · Section Overview

This section establishes the policies and operational requirements applicable to all volunteers affiliated with a specific team operated by @sunnybasin or @ragdulls.

All volunteers are expected to participate in upcoming projects and fulfill the responsibilities they are given upon volunteering. Volunteers who commit to a project are expected to contribute reasonably in accordance with their agreed responsibilities or complete tasks assigned by team leadership. Failure to fulfill these obligations may result in disciplinary action pursuant to Subsection B.5.

Any volunteer who undertakes or becomes involved in an additional project that may affect their existing commitments must notify the appropriate team leadership in advance. Failure to provide such notification may result in disciplinary action pursuant to Subsection B.5.

C.2 · Policies

C.2.1 · Agreement Compliance

All team members are required to comply with all sections of the Agreement (Sections A through D). Failure to comply with any applicable provision may result in disciplinary action pursuant to Subsection B.5.

C.2.2 · Intellectual Property

All intellectual property contributed to projects belonging to a specific team operated by @sunnybasin or @ragdulls shall be subject to the ownership and licensing provisions established in Subsection B.3. This includes, but is not limited to, code, music, models, writing, designs, animations, and other creative or technical materials.

Contributors are permitted to display their contributions in personal portfolios, applications, or professional demonstrations, provided that doing so does not violate confidentiality obligations or disclose unauthorized team materials.

C.2.3 · Compensation

Unless expressly announced by team leadership, no volunteer shall be entitled to any portion of the revenue or earnings generated by projects belonging to a specific team operated by @sunnybasin or @ragdulls, including videos, video games, or other published materials. Any exceptions must be specifically announced by the appropriate team leadership.

C.2.4 · Recommendations and Playtesting

All volunteers are permitted to submit recommendations, conduct approved playtests, and communicate suggestions or concerns to team leadership. Official playtests require prior approval from the appropriate team leadership.

C.2.5 · Contributor Recognition

All individuals who contribute to a project belonging to a specific team operated by @sunnybasin or @ragdulls, regardless of the extent of their contribution, shall receive acknowledgment in an appropriate form. Such acknowledgment may include:

- Inclusion in the credits of a video or other published content.
- Mention within a video or its accompanying description.
- Attribution in the description of a musical composition or specific song.
- Inclusion in a video game's credits or description.
- Recognition through an in-game acknowledgment or Easter egg.
- Other appropriate forms of recognition.

Volunteers may request a specific method of acknowledgment. Such requests shall be accommodated provided they do not cause unreasonable delays or interfere with the project's release schedule. If the requested acknowledgment requires additional work, the volunteer may be required to prepare the material themselves.

C.2.6 · Leave and Inactivity

A volunteer who becomes unable to participate in a project may be temporarily removed from the active team or placed on leave until they are able to resume participation. Such removal shall not constitute disciplinary action and shall serve as an administrative acknowledgment of the volunteer's unavailability.

Reinstatement may require the volunteer to complete the current version of the Agreement again.

C.2.7 · Resignation and Reinstatement

Volunteers may resign from their respective teams and subsequently request reinstatement, subject to approval by the appropriate team leadership. Individuals who have been permanently suspended or blacklisted pursuant to Subsection B.5 may be ineligible for reinstatement.

C.2.8 · Continuing Obligations

Following resignation, suspension, or removal, individuals remain subject to the confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations established in Section D for the applicable duration.

Violations may result in temporary or permanent exclusion from participation in any specific team operated by @sunnybasin or @ragdulls, as determined by the appropriate team leadership and subject to applicable law.

C.3 · Team Expectations

All volunteers are expected to comply with the following requirements and fulfill their assigned responsibilities within the established deadlines:

C.3.1 · Deadlines

Official project deadlines and release dates may only be established or modified by the appropriate team leadership. Volunteers shall not independently extend deadlines, announce alternative release dates, or communicate unofficial scheduling changes as authorized decisions.

Requests for extensions must be submitted to team leadership with reasonable justification. Unless approved, the original deadline shall remain in effect. Violations may result in disciplinary action pursuant to Subsection B.5.

C.3.2 · Contributions

Volunteers are expected to contribute reasonably in accordance with their assigned responsibilities and existing commitments. Individuals who are unable to fulfill their responsibilities must notify team leadership as soon as reasonably practicable.

Exemptions or alternative assignments may be granted at the discretion of team leadership.

C.3.3 · Artificial Intelligence

The use of artificial intelligence is permitted for coding and written creative content.

The use of generative AI to create project models, artwork, music, animations, or other visual and audio assets is strictly prohibited unless expressly authorized by team leadership.

C.3.4 · Third-Party Assets

The use of publicly available or free third-party assets is permitted, provided that such assets are reviewed for malicious code, security vulnerabilities, and applicable licensing restrictions before being incorporated into a team project.

Any discovered malicious code or suspicious materials must be reported to team leadership immediately. Failure to exercise reasonable care or knowingly introducing harmful materials may result in disciplinary action pursuant to Subsection B.5.

C.3.5 · Project Reporting

Upon request, volunteers must provide truthful and accurate updates regarding their assigned responsibilities and project progress.

Knowingly providing false, misleading, or materially incomplete information, or deliberately withholding relevant project updates, may result in disciplinary action pursuant to Subsection B.5.

C.3.6 · Professional Conduct

All volunteers are expected to maintain professional and respectful conduct when interacting with other team members and leadership.

Team members shall not intentionally interfere with team operations or obstruct the completion of assigned responsibilities.

C.3.7 · Enforcement

Team leadership reserves the authority to interpret and enforce the policies established in this section, subject to the provisions of this Agreement.

Violations of these policies may be addressed in accordance with the disciplinary procedures established in Subsection B.5.


END OF SECTION C: TEAM POLICIES

sections.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
sections.content:
NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

Version 1.0
Author: @sunnybasin
Last Revised: November 17, 2026

This Non-Disclosure Agreement (hereinafter referred to as the "NDA") establishes the confidentiality requirements and disclosure restrictions applicable to all volunteers participating in the specific team's development activities.

Although this document is not intended to constitute a legally binding contract, all volunteers are expected to carefully review, understand, and comply with the provisions outlined herein. Failure to comply with the requirements of this NDA may result in disciplinary action, including the consequences specified in Subsection D.3.

Please note that violations of this NDA are subject to a separate set of reprimands from those outlined in Subsection B.5 of the Agreement. The disciplinary measures applicable to violations of this NDA are further specified in Subsection D.3.

By signing this Agreement, the volunteer acknowledges that they have read, understood, and agreed to comply with the confidentiality requirements and disclosure restrictions established herein.

 Terms and Definitions

For the purposes of this NDA, the following terms shall have the meanings assigned to them below:

- NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement): The document establishing the confidentiality requirements and restrictions concerning the disclosure of specific teamal and project-related information.
- Authorized Disclosure: The release, distribution, or communication of information that has been expressly approved by team leadership.
- Confidential / Confidentiality: The protection and restricted distribution of sensitive, private, or otherwise undisclosed information, limiting access to individuals who have been authorized to receive such information.
- Team Leadership: Individuals designated with specific teamal authority, specifically @ragdulls and @sunnybasin, unless otherwise specified.
- Volunteer: Any individual who participates in the specific team's development activities, regardless of their assigned position, responsibilities, or team.
- Project: Any game, development initiative, or other undertaking being developed, managed, or maintained by the specific team.
- Public Disclosure: The intentional release, publication, distribution, or communication of information to individuals who are not authorized to access confidential specific teamal information.
- Official Release: The formal publication or release of a project, as determined and authorized by team leadership.

 D.1 · Purpose

The purpose of this NDA is to establish clear guidelines concerning the disclosure and distribution of information obtained through participation in the specific team's development activities.

This NDA is intended to protect confidential project information from unauthorized disclosure to individuals outside the development environment, including prospective players, existing players, and other individuals who have not been authorized to receive such information.

In particular, these provisions are intended to prevent the unauthorized release of unreleased project details, development materials, internal content, and other information that may compromise project confidentiality or reveal unreleased features and content.

All volunteers are responsible for ensuring that information obtained through their participation in the specific team is disclosed only in accordance with the provisions established herein.

The confidentiality requirements established by this NDA apply regardless of the communication method, platform, or medium through which the information is obtained or potentially disclosed.

 D.2 · Confidential Information and Authorized Disclosure

D.2.1 · Permitted Public Disclosure

Unless otherwise specified by team leadership, volunteers are permitted to publicly disclose the following information concerning an specific team's project:

- The project's official release date.
- The official name of the project.
- Information that has already been publicly disclosed by team leadership (@ragdulls or @sunnybasin).
- Any additional information that has received explicit authorization from team leadership for public disclosure.

All other project-related information shall be considered confidential unless expressly authorized for public disclosure.

D.2.2 · Confidential Information

Confidential information includes, but is not limited to:

- The project's genre, gameplay mechanics, and general development direction, unless previously authorized for public disclosure.
- Unreleased features, content, and planned additions.
- Development assets, including models, images, animations, audio, scripts, and other project materials.
- Internal development progress, discussions, and decisions.
- Unreleased announcements, promotional materials, and project updates.
- Internal documents, administrative procedures, and specific teamal information.
- Private communications between volunteers and team leadership.
- Information concerning internal disagreements, disciplinary matters, or administrative decisions.
- Any other information obtained through participation in the development process that has not been approved for public disclosure.

Volunteers are strictly prohibited from disclosing, distributing, publishing, or otherwise making confidential information accessible to unauthorized individuals without prior approval from team leadership.

D.2.3 · Restrictions on Distribution

Confidential information may not be reproduced, copied, recorded, photographed, screenshotted, or otherwise distributed to unauthorized individuals without prior authorization from team leadership.

This restriction applies to all forms of communication and distribution, including, but not limited to:

- Private messages and direct messages including the specified project.
- Screenshots and screen recordings.
- Audio recordings.
- Downloadable materials.

Volunteers are additionally prohibited from intentionally providing unauthorized individuals with access to internal development channels, confidential documents, project files, or other restricted specific teamal resources.

D.2.4 · Exceptions and Additional Restrictions

Team leadership reserves the right to designate otherwise permissible information as confidential. Accordingly, information that would ordinarily be permitted for public disclosure under Subsection D.2.1 shall become restricted if team leadership explicitly determines that it must remain confidential.

Likewise, volunteers may only disclose information that has been expressly authorized for public disclosure, including any additional information that team leadership may subsequently approve for disclosure.

The absence of an explicit confidentiality designation does not independently grant permission to disclose information outside the scope of the authorized disclosures listed in Subsection D.2.1.

The following circumstances shall generally not constitute unauthorized disclosure:

- Information that has already been officially released through authorized public channels.
- Information that team leadership has explicitly approved for public disclosure.
- Information that must be disclosed pursuant to an applicable legal requirement, subject to any legally permissible notice and other applicable obligations.
- Disclosures protected by applicable law, including legally protected reports of unlawful conduct.

Volunteers should consult team leadership before disclosing information when its confidentiality status is uncertain, where doing so is lawful and appropriate.

 D.3 · Consequences and Reprimands

Any volunteer found to have violated the confidentiality requirements or disclosure restrictions established in this NDA may be subject to disciplinary action.

Depending on the nature, severity, and frequency of the violation, team leadership may impose one or more of the following consequences:

- Verbal Warning: A formal verbal notification informing the volunteer of the violation and the requirement to comply with the NDA.
- Temporary Team Suspension: Temporary removal of the volunteer from their assigned team or development responsibilities for a period determined by team leadership.
- Permanent Team Suspension: Permanent removal of the volunteer from their assigned team, resulting in the termination of their participation in that team's activities.

The consequences listed above are not required to be administered in sequential order. Team leadership reserves the discretion to determine the appropriate disciplinary action based on the circumstances surrounding each violation.

In determining the appropriate reprimand, consideration may be given to:

- The severity and extent of the disclosure.
- Whether the violation was intentional or accidental.
- Whether the volunteer has previously committed similar violations.

Team leadership retains the authority to determine and administer disciplinary measures in accordance with the circumstances of each individual case.

 D.4 · Duration, Return of Materials, and Acknowledgment

D.4.1 · Duration and Applicability

This NDA shall become applicable to a volunteer upon the commencement of their participation in a specific project. Its active applicability shall continue throughout the development and preparation of that project until its Official Release has been completed.

Upon the completion of the project's Official Release, the active applicability of this NDA to that specific project shall conclude, unless otherwise determined by team leadership.

Each subsequent project shall constitute a separate period of applicability under this NDA. Accordingly, volunteers participating in multiple projects shall be subject to the confidentiality requirements established herein for each respective project.

Notwithstanding the conclusion of a project's release period, the termination of a volunteer's participation, or the expiration of this NDA's active applicability to that project, volunteers shall remain prohibited from disclosing confidential information obtained during their participation for as long as such information remains confidential, subject to applicable law and the exceptions established in Subsection D.2.4.

The conclusion of a project's release period does not independently authorize the disclosure of unreleased content, restricted development materials, private specific teamal information, or other information that remains confidential.

D.4.2 · Acknowledgment and Agreement

By signing this NDA, the volunteer acknowledges and confirms the following:

- They have read and reviewed the entirety of this Non-Disclosure Agreement.
- They understand the confidentiality requirements and restrictions established herein.
- They understand which information may be disclosed publicly and which information must remain confidential.
- They agree to comply with the applicable confidentiality requirements throughout their participation in each respective project.
- They understand that unauthorized disclosure may result in disciplinary action, including temporary or permanent suspension from their assigned team.
- They understand that confidentiality obligations concerning information that remains confidential may continue following the completion of a project's Official Release or the termination of their participation, subject to applicable law.

The volunteer further acknowledges that their signature represents their acceptance of the internal confidentiality policies and expectations established by this NDA.

By providing their signature, the volunteer confirms that they have had the opportunity to review this document and seek clarification regarding any provisions they do not understand.

END OF SECTION D: NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT
